title: Harms of Gender Exclusivity and Challenges in Non-Binary Representation in Language Technologies

bias_targets.methodology: The paper uses multiple methods: 1) A survey of non-binary individuals to identify representational and allocational harms in NLP tasks like NER, Coreference Resolution, and Machine Translation; 2) Nearest-neighbor analysis, cosine similarity, and WEAT tests on GloVe embeddings to measure sentiment and occupational associations with binary vs. non-binary words; 3) Masked language modeling tests in BERT to evaluate pronoun prediction (misgendering), occupational associations, and the ability to classify singular vs. plural 'they'; 4) PCA-based subspace analysis to demonstrate the lack of non-binary representation in the computed gender subspace.
